column1: # Move. Rule: module is package; struct and enum are class; const is constant;
# every fun is function, whatever its visibility or modifier (public,
# public(friend), public(package), entry, native, #[test], and the ones in a
# script). `spec fun` is function. A `spec name { }` block conditions a function
# declared elsewhere and is not a definition; struct fields, locals, use
# declarations and calls are not either. The name of `module 0x42::ledger` is
# `ledger`. A function with attributes (#[view]) starts on the attribute line.
# label.move is the Move 2024 `module a::b;` form, read from ERROR nodes.
